scope: Resumable frozen HMR2a image-only raw25 feature sidecar builder. No trainable model, labels, weights or cache input modified.
changes: Unique-frame shards of 128 or 256 with immutable contract and per-shard content hashes.
Resume binds parameters, seed, environment, actual VACE file SHA, checkpoint/config/assets/source/annotations/image SHA, ordered frame/window UIDs and lookup digest.
Formal full split coverage reconstructed from original VACE window planner including all owner masks and metric-only boundary keys.
Explicit diagnostic development override always yields development_only=true and never accepts test split.
Raw rectangular poses2d crop margin 0.25 and original HMR2 aspect crop/extractor retained.
Frame-budget pause, merge-only resume, interrupted shard publication recovery, committed shard tamper/missing/unrecorded rejection.
torch.from_file merge tensors plus native torch.save storage writer; Linux msync/madvise and background page advice, observed memory not hard RSS guarantee.
No-overwrite final files, actual final SHA, disk reload validation and exact private temporary-file cleanup boundaries.
GPU allocator cap defaults 8 GiB, batch 2, workers 0, CPU threads 4, seed 2026.
Portable lazy CLI imports avoid vace/models shadowing external wan package.

result.paging_limit: OS-managed clean file pages; RSS is observed, not a guaranteed hard cap

limitations: Synthetic tests verify storage/resume mechanisms only; real raw-data schema, HMR checkpoint loading, CUDA forward and Linux paging still require server pilot.
Final .pt publication before completion report is possible on process death; independent read-only stage verifier must reconstruct acceptance from final native schema and immutable work contract.
Mmap pages are OS-managed; CUDA allocator cap does not limit all driver memory or guarantee system RSS.
real_pilot_repair: Call preserved evaluate_standard_3dpw.enable_legacy_chumpy_compatibility before HMR SMPL construction under NumPy 1.26; no package/weight/preprocessing edits.
